verdict.rationale: AgentMail's API reference documents an official Python SDK and states that all of its SDKs are open source under the MIT license. The homepage shows a JavaScript-style client call, and community users praised dashboard popovers that show SDK examples. missing for 10: an explicit documented list of supported SDK languages beyond Python (TypeScript/Node is only implied by a code snippet), and independent hands-on reports of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use our Python SDK for seamless integration with your Python applications.
All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.
Praise for the dashboard's popovers showing SDK examples
